add_team: Add a team. Body: name. Returns the team including its id.
create_fixture: Schedule a fixture. Body: home_team_id, away_team_id (ids of existing teams), date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the fixture including its id. Refused when both ids are the same team or a team does not exist.
get_fixture: Get one fixture by its id, with home_team_id, away_team_id, date, home_goals and away_goals (empty/null until a score is recorded). Path params: id.
record_score: Record the score of a fixture. Path params: id (the fixture). Body: home_goals, away_goals (whole numbers, 0 or more). Refused when a number is negative.
team_fixtures: List every fixture a team plays in, at home or away. Path params: id (the team).
